fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-06-07 states that a parked car of the complainant near Kalai Puram Apartment Complex in Chennai was defaced and partly broken, on 2025-06-06 at approximately 20:05. Elango Krishnan approached Chennai Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000081. Udhay Muthu (9000000352), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Prakash Palanisamy, using the number 9000000156. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unidentified persons allegedly damaged the property while it was unattended.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, apartment complex, mobile number, CCTV, evening, suspect, photograph
